remarks: Great investment opportunity that is moments to Greenwich, large shopping centers/big box stores yet still located on a quiet low traffic street. 2 very spacious apartments: First floor apartment offers living room with fireplace, 3 bedrooms, large kitchen, hardwood floors under carpet, finished playroom on lower level along with an extra bath, laundry and attached one car garage. Second floor sunny and bright apartment offers 4 very large rooms including 2 bedrooms and living room with hardwood floors, kitchen with outdoor balcony. Lovely flat level lot. Apartments are on separate electric meters and cable. However heat and water are shared. This is an "as is" estate sale. First floor unit is vacant. Upper apartment will be vacated on Sept. 4th. Note: new dishwasher on first floor apartment.
